text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond took the train to run an 
errand for the dorm head, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
“......Oh? Wasn't the station we just 
passed where we were supposed to get off?”

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"To think I'd miss my stop... I need to 
head back and make it to my destination 
this time."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Umm, the next train is... an express! That 
should get us back quickly!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so fast... wait, oh dear?! Did I 
miss my stop again...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond returned late from her 
errand, making the dorm head worry...
